description_en: Re-connects a cloud service to WAF. This operation is used only when the cloud native mode connection status is protection exception
description_zh: 云产品重新接入WAF，仅在云产品接入的状态为防护异常时使用
kebab_example: aliyun waf-openapi re-create-cloud-resource --instance-id waf_v2_public_cn-000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ReCreateCloudResource

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the WAF instance.

You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html to query the ID of the current WAF instance
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例的ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html查询当前WAF实例的ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the cloud service instance
parameters.name: resource_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The port of the cloud service connected to WAF
parameters.name: port

parameters.help_en: The type of the cloud service
parameters.name: resource_product

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the connected resource, which is automatically generated by WAF in cloud native mode.

You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2839876.html to connect a resource and then view the resource ID in the response
parameters.help_zh:
已接入的资源ID，云产品接入时由WAF自动生成。

您可以通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2839876.html接入资源后，查看响应中的资源ID
parameters.name: cloud_resource_id

parameters.help_en:
The region where the WAF instance resides. Valid values:

cn-hangzhou: the Chinese mainland.

ap-southeast-1: outside the Chinese mainland
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

cn-hangzhou：表示中国内地。

ap-southeast-1：表示非中国内地
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The Alibaba Cloud resource group ID
parameters.name: resource_manager_resource_group_id
